description: This file provides utility functions for resolving, analyzing, and grouping extension test plans within a software project. It includes functionalities for locating extension directories, counting test files, merging plans, and creating test shards for parallel execution.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts file paths to a normalized form with forward slashes.

methods.name: countTestFiles
methods.description: Counts the number of test files (with .test.ts or .test.tsx extensions) under a given directory.

methods.name: resolveExtensionDirectory
methods.description: Resolves the directory path of an extension based on input arguments or current working directory, verifying presence of package.json.

methods.name: resolveExtensionTestPlan
methods.description: Generates a test plan for a specified extension, including configuration type, test files, and roots.

methods.name: mergeTestPlans
methods.description: Merges multiple test plans into a grouped summary, aggregating extension IDs, roots, and test file counts.

methods.name: resolveExtensionBatchPlan
methods.description: Creates a grouped plan for multiple extensions, combining their individual plans.

methods.name: pickLeastLoadedShard
methods.description: Selects the shard with the fewest test files and plans for load balancing.

methods.name: createExtensionTestShards
methods.description: Splits extension test plans into shards for parallel testing, balancing by load.
